BugInfo.Description:
Apache Axis 2为开发人员提供了可通过Java applet监视输入和输出SOAP消息的功能，攻击者可以使用SOAP Monitor截取Web服务与其客户端之间的信息流。
**例如**：如下web.xml中Axis2配置错误调试信息 ```xml <servlet> <servlet-name>SOAPMonitorService</servlet-name> <display-name>SOAPMonitorService</display-name> <servlet-class> org.apache.axis.monitor.SOAPMonitorService </servlet-class> <init-param> <param-name>SOAPMonitorPort</param-name> <param-value>5001</param-value> </init-param> <load-on-startup>100</load-on-startup> </servlet> ```
BugInfo.Advice: 移除配置文件中SOAP Monitor模块相关的引用，禁用SOAP Monitor。确保web.xml中不包含SOAP Monitor服务相关的`servlet`或者`servlet-mapping`。`axis2.xml`并删除诸如`<module ref="soapmonitor"/>`的引用。

References.Reference: 2007:A6 Information Leakage and Improper Error Handling
